rationale: Correct the existing Dauntless Energy record in place to Skyline Renewables, the identity in Ardian's census holding, live infrastructure portfolio and 2025 integrated report. Primary evidence disproves the repository's rebrand claim: Dauntless Energy was formed separately in summer 2024 to manage the distinct Skyline Renewables and 1370 Clean Energy portfolios. Preserve the existing Ardian ownership period, AAIF IV fund attribution and 2018 entry for Skyline; remove the unsupported duplicate vehicle text, correct the company boundary, headquarters, founding year and historical milestones, and retain projects beneath Skyline rather than creating additional PortCos. Ardian's exact Skyline stake, security class, immediate holding vehicle and platform-equity closing day are not publicly disclosed. No Skyline-level sale, completed exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Dauntless Energy
beforeImage.description: Dauntless Energy is Ardian's North American energy asset manager and independent power platform. The company develops, acquires, and manages wind, solar, storage, and efficient gas-fired generation assets serving wholesale power markets and contracted offtakers. Its operating model is asset-heavy and combines portfolio management, development, and operating oversight across multiple generation vehicles. Public materials identify Skyline Renewables, launched in 2018 through Ardian Americas Infrastructure Fund IV (AAIF IV), and 1370 Clean Energy, launched in 2025, as key portfolio vehicles managed by Dauntless in the United States. The platform traces back to Ardian's 2018 launch of Skyline Renewables with TPH and was rebranded as Dauntless Energy, while ownership percentages for the current management platform have not been publicly disclosed.

afterImage.name: Skyline Renewables
afterImage.description: Skyline Renewables is an Ardian-backed portfolio of operating and development-stage wind and solar generation assets in the United States. Ardian and Transatlantic Power Holdings created Skyline in 2018, and Ardian identifies it as an Ardian Americas Infrastructure Fund IV investment. Ardian's 2025 integrated report continues to include Skyline in its infrastructure portfolio, while Skyline's current public page says it is managed by Dauntless Energy from Arlington, Virginia. Dauntless is a separate management company formed in 2024 to manage Skyline and 1370 Clean Energy; it is not a legal rename of Skyline, and 1370 is not consolidated into this record. Individual generation projects remain assets beneath Skyline. Ardian reported more than 1,050 MW of controlled wind and solar capacity in 2020, while Dauntless's current profile describes approximately 1 GW of Skyline managed assets. Public sources do not disclose Ardian's exact Skyline stake, security class, immediate holding vehicle or exact platform-equity closing day, and no Skyline-level exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.
